mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative consumer sentiment and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in supply, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by >1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in real personal savings (RSAFS) signals accommodative monetary policy and increased consumer savings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.25% and RSAFS increases by >2% month-over-month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by >0.25% and RSAFS increases by >2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive consumer sentiment and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >100k and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp month-over-month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >100k and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances where GDPC1 shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >1% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% month-over-month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by >1% and CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% month-over-month.
